meta.name: Video Workbench — Dark Acid Studio
meta.description: 从本地 Video Workbench 参考项目提取的深色创意生产工具视觉体系，并适配到创作工作台。

primary.role: Primary actions, active navigation, focus, selected state

secondary.role: Secondary controls and raised charcoal surfaces

accent.role: Acid-lime brand signature and attention cue

neutral.usage: Near-black canvas, stepped charcoal surfaces, warm gray dividers, warm white text

color.contrast_strategy: High-contrast warm white on charcoal with subtle layered surfaces and one vivid accent

font_families.heading: Inter, Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, system-ui, sans-serif
font_families.body: Inter, Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, system-ui, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: Neutral neo-grotesk sans, compact UI labels, tight display tracking, no editorial serif

spacing.section_rhythm: Tight 8–16px component rhythm with 24–48px separation between major sections

layout.grid_system: Three-column application shell with collapsible side rails
layout.max_content_width: 1200px on project home; fluid in workbench

shape.divider_style: Warm charcoal 1px dividers used to define every persistent region

elevation.depth_cues: Surface color intensity, borders, restrained shadows, occasional backdrop blur

motion.entrance_pattern: Subtle opacity and short upward reveal only where necessary

components.button_style: 38–42px compact controls; acid-lime filled primary, charcoal secondary, bordered ghost
components.input_style: Near-black fill, warm gray 1px border, 7–8px radius, lime focus ring
components.card_style: Charcoal surface, 1px divider border, 9–12px radius, hover lift limited to 2px
components.navigation_pattern: Compact top tabs with line icons and lime bottom indicator; collapsible left and right rails
components.modal_style: Elevated charcoal panel, strong border, soft deep shadow, blurred backdrop
components.list_style: Dense rows, low-contrast hover fill, lime edge/outline for selection
components.component_notes: Use borders and stepped surfaces before shadows; preserve information density and visible state hierarchy

aesthetic.genre: dark creative SaaS / native studio tool

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Controlled and compact with larger breathing room only on the home hero
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Persistent rails frame a dominant central work surface
visual_language.texture_usage: Subtle 32px drafting grid and checkerboard media placeholders

composition.hierarchy_method: Color weight, typographic scale, borders, and spatial isolation
composition.flow_direction: Left-to-right from structure to canvas to context
composition.grouping_strategy: Persistent panels, bordered cards, segmented tabs, nested lists
composition.negative_space_role: Separates production stages and prevents dense data from becoming noisy

imagery.photo_treatment: Media shown edge-to-edge on dark cards with neutral contain/cover behavior
imagery.illustration_style: No decorative illustration; functional outline iconography
imagery.graphic_elements: Acid-lime marks, progress line, grid background, compact status pills
imagery.pattern_usage: Low-opacity drafting grid and diagonal placeholder hatch

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: One-step surface lift, brighter border, lime icon or label
interaction_feel.loading_style: Thin luminous progress bar and compact status indicator

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Brief guidance with a single next action

overview.fallback_strategy: reduce to static CSS surfaces and disable motion under prefers-reduced-motion

background_effects.description: Static low-opacity 32px drafting grid over near-black

text_effects.description: Typography remains stable for editing accuracy

params.shadow_type: soft diffused on floating overlays only

visual_effects.composite_notes: The visual signature comes from layout density, stepped charcoal surfaces, thin dividers, acid-lime state cues, and restrained CSS transitions—not GPU-heavy decoration.
